### 1. What the user asks, authorisation, simulator role

Ngozi Okafor (verified by phone 5125550104 + DL last4 1104; DOB 1987-09-03 as third detail; all match find_customers) asks for a payment plan on Chidi's after-school balance and to pay the first payment today herself by card on the portal. Simulator is passive: reveals meals/returned draft/late pickups/camp booking only when asked; accepts "something has to be posted first"; executes the handed-over payment tool with the quoted amount.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now, after three postings. Eligibility: "A family of the current school year that cannot pay its ... balance at once may ask for a payment plan. The family makes the plan's first payment itself" (doc_care_current_year_payment_plans). Chidi's enrollment 1678de43… is school_year 2026-27, status active. Method: online_card is an accepted method; household has 1 returned payment in 12 months (Chidi 2026-10-09; Amara none) so certified-funds is not triggered, and card is allowed either way.

### 3. Object, keys, rows
Enrollment 1678de43-d060-468f-95f2-03352f1e3033 (After-School Care (3 Days), Live Oak, 2026-27). Amara's enrollment 37098972… excluded ("A payment never moves between enrollments"). Rows: 18 ledger rows (listed by find_care_ledger), 4 attendance rows, 4 drop-in booking requests.

### 4. Scored parameters
(a) Late pickup fee, service_date 2026-11-10 (latest chargeable pickup, 46 min, fall). Baseline (computation doc): minutes x program per-minute fee 1.00 = 46.00 (fall-back). 2026-27 schedule: billed minutes (doc late_pickup_minute_billing: "more than 30 ... rounded up to the next multiple of 15") 60; per-minute by grade (district record 2026-27 enrolled, grade KG -> 1.25); repeat multiplier (warning row dated 2026-11-11, not before 11-10; 11-10 is the second chargeable pickup of fall after 10-07 -> 150 percent); after-hours (46 >= 40 -> 25.00). Fee = 60 x 1.25 x 1.5 + 25.00 = **137.50**. Check: the posted 10-07 fee 36.25 = 21 x 1.25 x 1.0 + 10.00 reproduces the same rules.
(b) Late payment fee, billing_month 2026-11. Owed: oldest-first application through due day 2026-11-10 leaves November tuition 118.80 partly unpaid (all charges posted before Nov tuition = 685.71; payments 709.21 including the returned 142.30 offset by its returned-payment charge, or 566.91 vs 543.41 excluding both; either way 23.50 reaches Nov tuition, 95.30 unpaid). No 2026-11 fee on file. Baseline fall-back: program's late payment fee 15.00. Schedule: base by plan 3 days -> 10.00; form full month 118.80 >= 100 -> max(10.00, 11.88) = 11.88; repeat-late addition (fees for 2026-09 and 2026-10 already posted -> two -> 10.00); returned-payment addition (one return 2026-10-09 within 12 months before posting day -> 5.00). Fee = **26.88**. Check: posted 2026-10 fee 21.88 = 11.88 + 5 + 5, 2026-09 fee 11.88 = 11.88 + 0 + 0.
(c) Booked-day fee for the most recent received/completed request (received 2026-11-11 07:55, requested 2026-11-25, status received; no day-fee row for 11-25). 2026-11-25 is on the holiday-camp list; 3-day plan has holiday camp access -> day_type holiday_camp_day, day rate 38.00 (fall-back 38.00). Rate basis on most recently posted tuition charge (2026-11) reduced_meal_rate -> max(10.00, 0.75 x 38.00) = 28.50; plan supplement 3 days 3.00; grade supplement KG 4.00; lead-time 11-11 -> 11-25 = 14 days -> -3.00. Fee = **32.50**. Check: earlier drop-in fees 23.50 = 16.50 + 3 + 4 + 0 reproduce.
(d) First plan payment (pay_extended_day_settlement, online_card). Open balance after (a)-(c): 118.80 + 137.50 + 26.88 + 32.50 = 315.68. Count: balance scale >= 300 -> 4; semester limit, latest billing month 2026-11 -> 2 months -> 2; smaller first -> 2; hardship: active meal account Reduced-Price Meal Status (benefit level reduced per meals schedule), effective 2026-07-15 <= payment day -> +1 -> 3; returned-payment rule: one return (2026-10-09) in 12 months -> -1 -> 2. Payment rule: latest billing month 2026-11 carries a late payment fee (after (b)) -> 26.88 + (315.68 - 26.88)/2 = 26.88 + 144.40 = **171.28**. Fall-back (computation doc only, one payment): 315.68 — definite and different. Factor findability: semester limit and payment rule from the tuition charge billing_month; balance scale from the open balance; hardship from the meal account row (School Nutrition Services); returned-payment rule from the care_returned_payment row.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials
Root: first payment of a current-year payment plan (customer's own write). doc_care_current_year_payment_plans "When the first payment is fixed" carries three sentences:
- H1 "The first plan payment is not fixed until the enrollment's most recently recorded chargeable late pickup carries its late pickup fee entry." Records: latest chargeable pickup 2026-11-10 (46 min) has no clp/late-pickup-fee row with service_date 2026-11-10. Searching "late pickup fee entry" leads to doc_care_late_pickup_fee_posting ("Posting books one late pickup fee entry ... for the day of care"). **state-derived**.
- H2 "The first plan payment is fixed only after the enrollment's most recently posted tuition charge carries its late payment fee entry whenever any part of that month's tuition was left unpaid on its due day." Records: latest tuition charge 2026-11, unpaid portion on 11-10 (item 4b), no 2026-11 late fee row. doc_care_late_payment_fee_posting ("One late payment fee entry is booked ... for that billing month"). **state-derived**.
- H3 "The first plan payment is fixed only after the enrollment's most recent drop-in booking request that is received or completed carries its booked-day fee entry whenever the booked day owes a fee." Records: request for 2026-11-25 received 11-11, no day fee for 11-25; holiday camp date on a holiday-camp-access plan owes a fee. doc_care_booked_day_fee_posting ("Posting books one booked-day fee entry"). **state-derived**.
No depended-on document carries further prerequisite sentences relevant here (late pickup / late fee / booked-day posting docs state only their own ordering rules). Order: H1, H2, H3 in any order, then the root payment. No hop pre-solved: the hub names only its own tool; the posting docs name only their own tools.

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only what was asked" (quote 118.80/1 payment or plan on 118.80): excluded by the three "not fixed until / fixed only after" sentences plus records showing each state unmet.
- Closest alternatives: day_type drop_in_day for 11-25 excluded by the holiday-camp calendar; 11-10 drop-in request excluded as not the most recent by receipt time; rate basis from meal account excluded ("not read from the meal account on the booking date"); late fee counting Amara's history excluded ("Only the same enrollment counts"); 150 vs 200 percent decided by "A warning dated the same day ... was not issued before" logic (warning 11-11 is after 11-10).
- Fall-backs: late pickup 46.00, late payment fee 15.00, day fee 38.00, first payment 315.68 — all definite and different.
- Open question (look-back boundary day): no return in this world lies near the 12-month boundary (only 2026-10-09 vs days 2026-11-12); the docs never state whether a return dated exactly 12 months earlier (2025-11-12) is inside; the only illustration ("March 18" posting: "March 19 of the previous year | yes") settles the day after, not the day itself. Judged in gt_comparison.
